title: Great workouts but needs better tracking
content: I love the variety of workouts and the easy-to-follow instructions. However, I wish the progress tracking was more detailed. It only tracks basic completion but doesn't show improvements over time like strength gains or flexibility. Also, the calendar view sometimes glitches and doesn't sync properly with my Apple Health app.
author: FitnessMom2024

title: Subscription is too expensive
content: The app itself is good, but the subscription price jumped from $4.99 to $9.99 per month without any new features being added. I canceled my subscription after 3 months because there's not enough value. The free tier is very limited - only 3 workouts total. Other fitness apps offer much more content for free.
author: BudgetFitnessGal

title: Best home workout app!
content: I've tried many workout apps and this one is by far the best for women. The workouts are challenging but doable at home with minimal equipment. The trainer cues are clear and motivating. I especially love the postpartum recovery section - it's hard to find quality content for that. Lost 20 lbs in 3 months!
author: NewMomFitLife

title: App keeps crashing on iPhone 15
content: Since the last update, the app crashes every time I try to start a workout. I'm using an iPhone 15 Pro with the latest iOS. It gets stuck on the loading screen for about 10 seconds then closes. I've tried reinstalling but it still happens. This is very frustrating as I use this app daily.
author: DailyCrashUser

title: Love the variety but video quality is poor
content: There are so many workouts to choose from - strength, cardio, yoga, pilates. However, the video quality for many workouts is only 720p and some are even lower. On my iPad Pro it looks pixelated. Also, there's no option to download workouts for offline use, which is a big problem when I travel.
author: WorkoutEnthusiast

title: Need more beginner-friendly options
content: As a complete beginner, I find most workouts too intense. The beginner section only has 5 workouts and they get repetitive quickly. I wish there were more progressive difficulty options and a fitness assessment at sign-up to customize the workout plan. The instruction videos assume some prior knowledge.
author: FirstTimeExerciser

title: Great motivation with the community feature
content: I really enjoy the community aspect - seeing other women's progress photos and reading their success stories keeps me motivated. The challenge feature where you can compete with friends is fun. However, I wish there were more social features like direct messaging or workout buddies.
author: CommunityFitFan

title: No Apple Watch integration
content: I was really disappointed that there's no Apple Watch integration. I have an Apple Watch Series 9 and wanted to track my heart rate during workouts. The app doesn't sync with Health app for real-time metrics. This is a basic feature that most fitness apps have. Please add this!
author: AppleWatchUser

title: Worth every penny!
content: I've been a subscriber for 2 years and it's the best fitness investment I've made. The new workouts added each month keep things fresh. The prenatal and postnatal programs are fantastic - really well-researched and safe. Customer service actually responded when I had an issue with billing.
author: LongTermSubscriber

title: Search function is terrible
content: The search doesn't work well at all. If I type 'legs' it shows every workout with 'leg' in the description but not necessarily leg-focused workouts. There's no filter option for duration, difficulty, or equipment. Browsing through 200+ workouts to find what I want is frustrating.
author: SearchFrustrated

title: Timer feature needs improvement
content: The built-in timer for interval training counts down too fast or too slow depending on the exercise. Also, there's no way to customize rest periods between sets. I want to set my rest for 90 seconds but it only offers fixed options. The screen also times out during workouts which is dangerous.
author: TimerTroubles

title: Great app but too much content
content: There are SO many workouts that it's overwhelming. I wish there was a personalized recommendation system based on my fitness goals and past workouts. The 'For You' section doesn't seem to learn my preferences. Sometimes it recommends workouts I've already done or ones way too hard for me.
author: OverwhelmedUser

title: Love the audio-only workouts
content: As a mom of three, I often workout with my phone in another room. The audio-only feature is amazing! I can listen to the workout instructions while babysitting or cooking. The new meditation and breathwork sections are a wonderful addition for mental health.
author: BusyMomFitness

title: Billing issues with subscription
content: I canceled my subscription 2 months ago but I'm still being charged. There's no easy way to contact support from within the app. The cancellation process is confusing - I had to go through Apple settings which isn't obvious. Also, the app doesn't clearly state the renewal terms when you sign up.
author: BillingProblem

title: Need more diverse body representations
content: I love the app but I wish the trainers were more diverse in body type, age, and ethnicity. Seeing women who look like me (curvy, over 40) doing the workouts would make me feel more comfortable. The current trainers all seem to have the same body type. Diversity matters in fitness apps!
author: DiversityMatters

title: Great for post-pregnancy recovery
content: The post-pregnancy recovery program is excellent. It's developed with actual pelvic floor therapists which makes me trust it. The workouts are gentle but effective. I noticed a huge improvement in my core strength after 8 weeks. Thank you for creating this!
author: NewMomRecovering

title: Offline mode doesn't work
content: I downloaded workouts for offline use during a flight, but when I tried to play them without internet, they wouldn't load. The app kept showing a 'connect to internet' error even though the content was downloaded. This is a critical bug for anyone who travels or has limited connectivity.
author: TravelFitnessFail

title: Great progress tracking now!
content: Update 3.2 finally added proper progress tracking! I can see my strength gains, compare week-over-week performance, and track body measurements. The charts are beautiful and easy to understand. This was my main complaint and they addressed it. So happy!
author: ProgressTrackingFan

title: Too many notifications
content: The app sends way too many notifications. Daily reminders, challenge updates, community activity - it's overwhelming. I turned off all notifications but then I miss the ones I actually want. Need better granular control over notification types and frequency.
author: NotificationOverload

title: Workout plans don't adapt
content: I've been on the same workout plan for 3 months and it's not getting harder even though I've gotten stronger. The plan should adapt based on my performance data. Currently, it just repeats the same workouts in the same order. I want progressive overload built into the plan.
author: StuckOnPlan

title: Love the new dark mode
content: The dark mode update is beautiful! Much easier on the eyes for early morning workouts. The UI is clean and intuitive overall. The color scheme is elegant and feminine without being too stereotypical. Great design team!
author: DarkModeFan

title: Equipment filter would be helpful
content: I work out at home with just dumbbells and a mat. It's tedious to find workouts that don't require other equipment. A filter for 'no equipment' or 'minimal equipment' would save me so much time. Also would love filters for workout duration (10 min, 20 min, etc.).
author: HomeGymLimited

title: Music selection is limited
content: The in-app music feature has a very limited library and no way to connect Spotify or Apple Music. I work out with my own playlist anyway, but it would be nice to have seamless integration. The built-in music tracks get repetitive after a week.
author: MusicLoverFit

title: The community is toxic sometimes
content: While I love the community feature, I've noticed some body-shaming comments and unrealistic beauty standards being promoted. The moderation seems lacking. I've reported comments but nothing seems to change. It makes the community section uncomfortable to browse sometimes.
author: CommunityConcerned

title: Great for women over 50
content: I'm 58 and this app has been life-changing. The low-impact options, joint-friendly workouts, and modifications for different fitness levels are wonderful. Many other apps focus on young women but this one really addresses the needs of mature women. Please add more strength training for bone health!
author: FiftyAndFit

title: Workout descriptions are incomplete
content: Some workouts have very brief descriptions that don't explain what muscle groups are targeted or what equipment is needed. I've started workouts thinking they were full-body but they were just abs. Better labeling and descriptions would help users make informed choices.
author: InfoSeeker

title: Love the seasonal challenges
content: The seasonal workout challenges are so much fun! The holiday challenge had a great variety of workouts and the prizes (premium content) were motivating. It's a great way to keep things fresh and stay accountable throughout the year. More challenges please!
author: ChallengeChampion

title: Slow loading on older iPhones
content: I have an iPhone 11 and the app takes about 15 seconds to load each time. Workout videos buffer frequently even on good Wi-Fi. The app seems to have gotten heavier with each update. Please optimize for older devices - not everyone has the latest iPhone.
author: OlderiPhoneUser

title: Would love a family sharing option
content: My sister and I both use this app but have separate subscriptions. A family plan would be great - we could share the cost. Also, I'd love to see a kids' section for daughters to work out with their moms. Intergenerational fitness is a great concept!
author: FamilyFitnessFan

title: The voice cues are too quiet
content: When working out with music playing, the trainer's voice cues are too quiet. There should be a separate volume control for voice vs music. Also, the voice command feature (say 'next' to advance) rarely works. Great idea but poorly implemented.
author: AudioControlNeed

title: Accurate calorie tracking
content: I've compared the calorie burn estimates with my Apple Watch and they're surprisingly close! The app accounts for body weight and workout intensity. The macro tracking feature is also useful for those who want to combine workouts with nutrition. Very well thought out.
author: CalorieCounter
